info.name: DSP Film Manager — Lab04
info.description: Manual REST verification for the Lab04 active-film selection surface (login, films-to-review, online snapshot, select/replace active film, clear active film, authorization/validation, logout). This collection exercises REST endpoints only. It does NOT verify WebSocket broadcast delivery to multiple clients, reconnect behavior, or multi-session presence semantics — those are covered exclusively by the automated Node test suite (npm run test:lab04, specifically scripts/lab04-realtime-tests.js). To manually observe the realtime channel as a supplemental check, connect any WebSocket client to {{baseUrl}} with the scheme changed to ws:// and path /ws (e.g. ws://localhost:3000/ws) while running these requests — Postman's own request runner is not used for this, since a plain REST collection cannot assert broadcast/reconnect/multi-session behavior.

exec: pm.test('Runner starts without an active session', () => pm.expect([204, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code));
console.log('Initial session reset status:', pm.response.code, '- 204 means a stale session was cleared; 401 means the jar was already anonymous.');
pm.test('Frank login status is exactly 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('session cookie exists after login', () => pm.expect(pm.cookies.has('connect.sid'), 'Missing connect.sid: enable the Postman cookie jar for this run').to.eql(true));

item.name: 2. Films to Review and Online Snapshot

exec: pm.test('response is a paginated film collection', () => pm.expect(page).to.include.key('films'));

pm.test('Frank is assigned to both seed films he reviews', () => { pm.expect(filmIds).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('filmIdAssignedOne')); pm.expect(filmIds).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('filmIdAssignedTwo')); });
pm.test('review is now active for film 1', () => { pm.expect(review.active).to.eql(true); pm.expect(String(review.filmId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('filmIdAssignedOne')); });

console.log('This request makes the online-snapshot check below independent of whatever active film a previous Runner/server session may have left set — the collection does not assume a pristine, just-started server.');
pm.test('online snapshot is an array', () => pm.expect(online).to.be.an('array'));

pm.test('Frank appears in the online snapshot exactly once', () => { pm.expect(frank, 'Frank not found in online snapshot').to.exist; pm.expect(online.filter(entry => entry.userId === 2)).to.have.lengthOf(1); });
pm.test('Frank shows film 1 as active (established by the previous request)', () => pm.expect(String(frank.filmId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('filmIdAssignedOne')));

item.name: Select assigned film 2 as active (replaces film 1)

exec: pm.test('review is now active for film 2', () => { pm.expect(review.active).to.eql(true); pm.expect(String(review.filmId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('filmIdAssignedTwo')); });

item.name: Verify online snapshot shows the replacement

exec: pm.test('Frank now shows film 2 as active, not film 1', () => { pm.expect(frank, 'Frank not found in online snapshot').to.exist; pm.expect(String(frank.filmId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('filmIdAssignedTwo')); });
pm.test('Frank still appears exactly once (no duplicate entry from the replacement)', () => pm.expect(online.filter(entry => entry.userId === 2)).to.have.lengthOf(1));
pm.test('clear active film status is 204', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));

item.name: Verify online snapshot shows no active film

exec: pm.test('Frank has no active film after clearing', () => { pm.expect(frank, 'Frank not found in online snapshot').to.exist; pm.expect(frank.filmId == null, 'expected filmId to be null/absent').to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Alice login status is exactly 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const user = pm.response.json(); pm.test('authenticated user is Alice', () => pm.expect(user.id).to.eql(1));
pm.test('private film selection returns 404 (not exposed as an active-selectable public film)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
